scheme: Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987
eligible_group: Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes, victims of trafficking or begar, women, children, persons with disabilities, victims of mass disasters and specified forms of violence, industrial workmen, persons in custody, and persons meeting the prescribed income criteria
benefit: Entitlement to free legal services, subject to the Act's requirements
authority_level: National, State, District and Taluk Legal Services Authorities

scheme: Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987
eligible_group: Persons satisfying any of the eligibility criteria under Section 12
benefit: Free legal services where the concerned authority is satisfied that the applicant has a prima facie case to prosecute or defend
authority_level: Concerned Legal Services Authority

scheme: NALSA (Free and Competent Legal Services) Regulations, 2010
eligible_group: Applicants seeking free legal services under Section 12 of the Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987
benefit: Application scrutiny and decision on legal aid; the decision is to be taken immediately and within seven days of receiving the application
authority_level: Supreme Court, State, High Court, District and Taluk Legal Services Institutions

scheme: Lok Adalat
eligible_group: Parties to pending court cases and parties to eligible pre-litigation disputes
benefit: Amicable settlement of eligible disputes through compromise; Lok Adalat awards are final and binding
authority_level: National, State, District and Taluk Legal Services Authorities

scheme: NALSA Compensation Scheme for Women Victims/Survivors of Sexual Assault/Other Crimes, 2018
eligible_group: Women victims or survivors of sexual assault and other covered crimes, including eligible dependants
benefit: Financial compensation and rehabilitation support under the scheme
authority_level: State Legal Services Authority and District Legal Services Authority

scheme: NALSA Legal Services to Disaster Victims through Legal Services Authorities Scheme, 2010
eligible_group: Persons affected by mass disasters, ethnic violence, caste atrocities, floods, droughts, earthquakes or industrial disasters who are under circumstances of underserved want
benefit: Access to legal services and assistance through Legal Services Authorities
authority_level: Taluk, District or State Legal Services Authority, depending on jurisdiction

scheme: NALSA Victims of Trafficking and Commercial Sexual Exploitation Scheme, 2015
eligible_group: Victims of human trafficking and commercial sexual exploitation
benefit: Legal services, legal awareness and assistance in accessing legal protections and remedies
authority_level: Taluk, District or State Legal Services Authority, depending on jurisdiction

scheme: NALSA Legal Services to Workers in the Unorganized Sector Scheme, 2015
eligible_group: Workers in the unorganized sector who need legal assistance concerning their rights and entitlements
benefit: Legal awareness and assistance in accessing applicable labour rights, welfare benefits and legal remedies
authority_level: Taluk, District or State Legal Services Authority, depending on jurisdiction

scheme: NALSA Effective Implementation of Poverty Alleviation Schemes, 2015
eligible_group: People facing difficulties in accessing applicable government poverty alleviation schemes and entitlements
benefit: Legal awareness and assistance in accessing applicable welfare schemes and resolving related legal obstacles
authority_level: Taluk, District or State Legal Services Authority, depending on jurisdiction

scheme: NALSA Protection and Enforcement of Tribal Rights Scheme, 2015
eligible_group: Members of tribal communities seeking protection or enforcement of their legal rights
benefit: Legal awareness and assistance concerning applicable tribal rights and legal protections
authority_level: Taluk, District or State Legal Services Authority, depending on jurisdiction

scheme: NALSA Legal Services to Victims of Drug Abuse and Eradication of Drug Menace Scheme, 2015
eligible_group: Persons affected by drug abuse and individuals requiring legal assistance in related matters
benefit: Legal awareness and assistance concerning legal rights, protections and available support mechanisms
authority_level: Taluk, District or State Legal Services Authority, depending on jurisdiction

scheme: NALSA Legal Services to Senior Citizens Scheme, 2016
eligible_group: Senior citizens requiring assistance concerning their legal rights and protections; free legal aid eligibility depends on applicable Tamil Nadu rules
benefit: Legal awareness and assistance concerning the rights and legal protections of senior citizens
authority_level: Taluk, District or State Legal Services Authority, depending on jurisdiction

scheme: NALSA Legal Services to Victims of Acid Attacks Scheme, 2016
eligible_group: Victims and survivors of acid attacks
benefit: Legal assistance and awareness concerning legal remedies, rights and available protections
authority_level: Taluk, District or State Legal Services Authority, depending on jurisdiction

scheme: NALSA Compensation Scheme for Women Victims or Survivors of Sexual Assault or Other Crimes, 2018
eligible_group: Women victims or survivors covered by the applicable compensation scheme
benefit: Victim compensation and rehabilitation support subject to the scheme's eligibility conditions and applicable procedures
authority_level: Tamil Nadu State Legal Services Authority or District Legal Services Authority

scheme: NALSA Child-Friendly Legal Services for Children Scheme, 2024
eligible_group: Children requiring legal assistance, protection or representation
benefit: Child-friendly legal services and assistance in accessing legal protection and justice mechanisms
authority_level: Taluk, District or State Legal Services Authority, depending on jurisdiction

scheme: NALSA Legal Services to Persons with Mental Illness and Persons with Intellectual Disabilities Scheme, 2024
eligible_group: Persons with mental illness and persons with intellectual disabilities
benefit: Legal assistance and support in accessing rights, protections and justice mechanisms
authority_level: Taluk, District or State Legal Services Authority, depending on jurisdiction

scheme: NALSA SHIKSHA Scheme for Holistic Inclusion, Knowledge and Schooling through Help and Access, 2026
eligible_group: Children and persons covered by the scheme's provisions concerning access to education and schooling
benefit: Legal services and assistance within the scheme's focus on educational access, inclusion and schooling
authority_level: Legal Services Authorities at the appropriate jurisdictional level

scheme: NALSA JAGRITI Scheme, 2025
eligible_group: People and communities targeted by the scheme's grassroots justice-awareness initiatives
benefit: Justice awareness and improved access to information about legal services through the scheme
authority_level: National Legal Services Authority and State or District Legal Services Authorities

scheme: NALSA DAWN Scheme - Drug Awareness and Wellness Navigation for a Drug-Free India, 2025
eligible_group: People and communities covered by the scheme's drug-awareness and prevention initiatives
benefit: Drug awareness and wellness-navigation support under the scheme
authority_level: National Legal Services Authority and State or District Legal Services Authorities

scheme: NALSA Scheme on Access to Justice for Victims of Human-Wildlife Conflict, 2025
eligible_group: Victims affected by human-wildlife conflict
benefit: Access-to-justice assistance and legal support under the scheme
authority_level: State or District Legal Services Authority, depending on jurisdiction
